answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 52263 Country: India Title: Distribution of property Question: My query is that my mamujan passed away three years back leaving behind only his wife as he had no child. My mother is the only surviving sister of my mamu. My mamu had a house built with his own resources (not an ancestral property). How will the same be divided among my mamani and my mother? Answer ID: 52263 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 871/721/H=06/1435) All the property (and the house) left by your mamu shall be divided into 4 shares, after paying due rights preceding inheritance. Out of the total, 1 share shall go to the widow while 3 shares to the only sister of the deceased person. The detail of the division is as follows: Details: Wife: 1x1=1 Sister: 1x3=3 Total: 4 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
